name: tuck jump v. 2
description: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
